bull_case_summary: Sime has a profitable diversified industrial and automotive base. The second bull points to the separate RM1.55bn core-profit headline as a reconciliation task and potential valuation investigation, while conceding that the low vendor multiple does not establish cheapness.
bear_case_summary: Rounded headline margins do not settle segment durability, and current leverage and FCF remain unreconciled. Round two accepts the limits of the margin proxy but stresses that the proposed core-profit reconciliation is not evidence of completed recurring-earnings verification.
key_points_of_agreement: FY26 revenue and profit establish a profitable base.
The approximate headline profit/revenue ratio is not a segment return measure.
Low vendor P/E and price consolidation cannot replace earnings-quality or cash checks.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether the core-profit headline and diversified base sufficiently strengthen a prospective valuation thesis despite incomplete reconciliation.
unresolved_uncertainties: Core-to-reported profit reconciliation and segment cyclicality.
Matched prior-year comparisons and current leverage/FCF.
Normalised valuation sufficient to distinguish value from cyclical earnings risk.
